scope: Local package-lock.json, installed package metadata and supplied top-level license/notice files; current src/game and synthetic optical samples; Vite production build inspected in memory without writing output. No network requests or dependency installation were performed for this audit.
limitations: This is a technical inventory, not legal advice or a determination of all copyright ownership.
SPDX values are declarations in the lockfile and package metadata, not an independent legal classification of every bundled source file.

No node_modules directory, development-tool package tarball, or downloaded test browser is intended to be redistributed in the game web release. Their supplied license and notice files remain in the installed packages.
Not-installed optional/platform packages were not downloaded or content-inspected. Upstream tarball-internal bundled component inventories are not exhaustively expanded here.
Inspect the final release again after changing dependencies, runtime imports, Vite configuration, assets, or packaging scope.
The project owner must confirm ownership/contributor rights and choose the project license; dependency licenses remain independent.

productionBundle.verification: Vite build({build:{write:false},logLevel:"silent"}) succeeded using the installed locked Vite and Rolldown. Generated output was inspected in memory; typechecking and browser functional validation are outside this inventory.
productionBundle.applicationModuleScope: All non-virtual JavaScript source modules in the output were under src/game; CSS modules were under src/game/ui.
productionBundle.notes: The Vite modulepreload polyfill can fetch linked module URLs. No external runtime asset URLs were found in the current application or emitted JavaScript/CSS/HTML. Tool-generated preload behavior does not establish that the bundle contains no networking code.

assets.uiGraphics: DOM/CSS shapes and text. Card suits are Unicode text characters (hearts, diamonds, clubs, spades), rendered by the user device fonts; no suit image or font file is bundled.
assets.fonts: CSS system/local fallback stack includes system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Malgun Gothic, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, Roboto and sans-serif. Naming these installed fonts does not redistribute them.
assets.opticalSamples: Nine deterministic synthetic PNG renders generated by repository scripts from frozen optical code patterns; not photographs or externally sourced stock artwork. They are documentation/research fixtures, not current game runtime assets.
assets.ownershipLimit: Repository generation paths and manifest hashes were inspected; original authorship, contributor rights, and publication authority require owner confirmation.
